messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] continuous relaxations?
parts:
These kinds of transformations are related to something called
the Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation in physics — the problem
is that you map a certain kind of discrete system into a highly
correlated continuous one. Those high correlations tend to
kill you for any realistic discrete problem, then there’s the problem
of finding the right transformation for an arbitrary discrete system
and incorporating a discrete + continuous system.
